owner_rules: Done means ALL evidence: implemented as specified (task id), a test that FAILED before and passes now, suites green, measured number vs target, docs regenerated, committed AND pushed to the contract's branch.
Never defer: no "later", "follow-up", "out of scope". If blocked: what blocks, what you tried, what you need; then continue with the next task.
Root cause, then fix: file:line + mechanism. No weakening tests, raising timeouts, skips, relaxed assertions.
No silent scope cuts: never lower targets, caps or test sizes without owner approval.
Never bypass guards: no --no-verify, no bypass env vars, no skip flags.
Deliver continuously: one task per commit, pushed to the contract's branch as it goes green.
Honest reporting: TASK-ID | status | commit | tests | measured vs target | missing.

tasks.title: README comparison with Mem0 is factual and fair
requirements: Mem0's April 2026 memory algorithm uses single-pass ADD-only extraction as a deliberate, published design choice; the README states it as that and does not say Mem0 gave up or abandoned anything (source, external and not re-read in this repository, confirm before signing: Mem0 blog post of 16 April 2026 and Mem0 documentation, read 31 Oct 2026)

The contrast stated is converge's own: deterministic CRDT merge of concurrent writers, offline merge without an LLM, explicit deletes, Strong Eventual Consistency under stated assumptions (source: converge README.md sections Foundation Layer and Architecture)
The README states the in-progress stale-replica delete fix as in progress, not as released (source: contract PGP-1.01)
No benchmark of another vendor is quoted as converge's own, and no disparagement (source: owner request of 31 Oct 2026)

criteria.statement: The README has the comparison section
The comparison states the published design choice
The README makes no claim that Mem0 gave up or abandoned a design

verifier.cmd: ! grep -Eqi 'Mem0 (gave up|abandon)|gave up on c' README.md

criteria.statement: CHARTER, ROADMAP and dashboard make no such claim

verifier.cmd: ! grep -Eqi 'Mem0 (gave up|abandon)|gave up on c' CHARTER.md ROADMAP.md dashboard.html

criteria.statement: The comparison section describes the choice as single-pass, ADD-only extraction

verifier.pattern: ^## A comparison with Mem0(?:(?!^## )[\s\S])*single-pass, ADD-only extraction

criteria.statement: The comparison section cites Mem0's own announcement
The comparison section cites Mem0's own migration guide
The comparison section calls the choice a published design decision, not a gap

verifier.pattern: ^## A comparison with Mem0(?:(?!^## )[\s\S])*It is a published design decision, not a gap

criteria.statement: The comparison section says neither design makes the other unnecessary

verifier.pattern: ^## A comparison with Mem0(?:(?!^## )[\s\S])*neither makes the other unnecessary

criteria.statement: The stale-replica delete fix is stated as in progress, not released
The comparison table has its seven property rows

verifier.cmd: for n in "Design choice" "What decides the stored result" "Offline merge" "Concurrent writers" "Deletes" "Formal property" "Byzantine contributors"; do grep -Eq "^\| $n \|" README.md || exit 1; done

criteria.statement: The comparison section quotes no benchmark number or percentage for Mem0 or for converge

verifier.cmd: ! awk '/^## A comparison with Mem0/{f=1;next} /^## /{f=0} f' README.md | grep -Eqi '[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)? ?(%|x |ms|tokens)'

criteria.statement: Committed and pushed on its own branch for review; nothing is pushed to main

stop_rules: No weakening of an existing test, no raised timeout, no skip, no widened scope; if blocked, report what blocks and continue with the next independent task.
